sentences.text: Maria wakes up at 6:30 every morning.
First, she takes a quick shower.
Then, she has breakfast with her family.
Finally, she drives to work.
Tom decided to make a sandwich for lunch.
First, he took two slices of bread.
Next, he added cheese and some lettuce.
After that, he cut the sandwich in half and ate it.
Last weekend, Sarah and her friends went to the countryside.
They left early in the morning to avoid traffic.
When they arrived, they set up a tent near the lake.
They spent the afternoon swimming and playing games.
It was one of the best weekends they had ever had.
James had always wanted to adopt a dog.
He visited the local animal shelter one Saturday morning.
There, he saw a small brown puppy looking up at him.
He knew immediately that she was the right one.
He filled out the forms and took her home that same day.
Reading is one of the most valuable habits a person can develop.
It helps improve vocabulary and general knowledge.
Moreover, reading regularly can reduce stress and improve concentration.
However, many people say they do not have enough time to read.
Therefore, experts suggest reading for just fifteen minutes before bed.
Even this small amount can make a big difference over time.
Working from home has become increasingly common in recent years.
Many employees enjoy the flexibility it offers.
For example, they can save time by not commuting to an office.
On the other hand, some workers find it difficult to stay focused.
As a result, companies are now experimenting with hybrid schedules.
Plastic pollution has become one of the biggest environmental challenges of our time.
Every year, millions of tonnes of plastic end up in the ocean.
This waste harms marine life and damages entire ecosystems.
Such damage is often irreversible, taking centuries to repair naturally.
Several governments have introduced bans on single-use plastics to address the problem.
These measures, while positive, are not enough on their own to solve the crisis.

sentences.text: Learning a second language offers numerous cognitive and social benefits.
Research shows that bilingual individuals tend to have better problem-solving skills.
This advantage is believed to come from constantly switching between two language systems.
In addition, speaking another language opens doors to different cultures and career opportunities.
Despite these benefits, many adults give up before reaching fluency.
Experts suggest that setting small, achievable goals is the key to staying motivated.
The automotive industry is undergoing a major transformation as electric vehicles gain popularity worldwide.
Sales of electric cars have more than doubled in the past three years alone.
One of the main reasons for this growth is increasing concern about air pollution in cities.
Governments have also played a role by offering tax incentives to buyers of electric vehicles.
Nevertheless, some challenges remain, particularly the limited availability of charging infrastructure.
Battery technology, too, still needs improvement to allow for longer driving ranges.
Industry analysts predict, however, that most of these obstacles will be overcome within the next decade.

links.cue: this growth (refers to doubling of sales)

topic: the role of universities in society

sentences.text: Universities have traditionally been regarded as institutions dedicated to the pursuit of knowledge and the advancement of society.
Throughout history, they have produced groundbreaking research that has shaped the modern world.
In recent decades, however, the role of higher education has come under increasing scrutiny.
Critics argue that many universities have shifted their focus towards profit, treating students more like customers than scholars.
This commercialisation, they claim, has led to rising tuition fees without a corresponding improvement in the quality of teaching.
Supporters of the current system, on the other hand, point out that universities must adapt to survive in a competitive global market.
They maintain that partnerships with industry provide students with practical skills and improve graduate employability.
Ultimately, the challenge lies in finding a balance between academic integrity and financial sustainability.

links.cue: however (shifts from positive history to scrutiny)
